findings.passage: Steele: Yes. No-Excuse voting worked well in 2020 and I support it going forward. Not everyone can get to the polls for election days. People have limitations through their employment, child care and for health reasons. Giving our citizens an opportunity by mail voting has increased participation while taking off the travel burden to the polls for seniors, single parents and workers who cannot easily make it to the polling station. Furthermore, I am convinced that mail in voting can and is being implemented in Pennsylvania in a manner that protects the integrity of the vote count.
findings.note: Answer in a WESA candidate survey (2022 House District 33 race) to whether she supports no-excuse mail-in voting. Says nothing about ID; relates to mail voting and vote-count integrity.
